d.why: Only on screen in AoS 7x03, where he is an Area 51 scientist who gives the disguised Coulson and Simmons a lab tour and is told to help evacuate; he is a helper in their mission, with no tie to anyone filed.
On screen in AoS 6x01, 6x02, 6x04 and 6x07-6x09 as one of Sarge's crew (6x05 is only a photo and 6x06/6x11 are mentions).
On screen in AoS 4x01, 4x05, 4x13, 4x15, 4x20 and 4x21 as an agent on May's strike team.
On screen in AoS 5x14, 5x15 and 5x18-5x21 as the Confederacy commander who besieges the Lighthouse.

Only on screen in AoS 1x05, where he is Chan's case agent who calls in Coulson's team and is killed on the raid; the episode is about Chan becoming Scorch, not him, and he has no family or boss tie to anyone filed.

Only on screen in AoS 1x12, in the side plot where Coulson and May catch him in Mexico City and he tells them how baby Skye was found; he is a witness, and the episode's main plot is the Academy storm.
Only on screen in AoS 7x07, where he is a bumbling Deke Squad member in the fight with the Sibyl-Bots; his only family is his brother Tommy, who has no file, and he is nobody's boss.

Only on screen in AoS 1x15, where he is a biker under Lorelei's spell who chokes his wife Rosie and is knocked out by Ward; he is Lorelei's henchman, and neither Rosie nor his Dogs of Hell bikers have files.
On screen in AoS 7x07 with the Deke Squad, and again in 7x10, where she lends the team the Lighthouse.
Only on screen in AoS 3x14 (his season 7 presence is mentions in 7x06/7x07), but he is the younger brother of Mack, who has a file.

Only on screen in AoS 7x07, where he is the electronics-store owner who builds Sibyl a robot body and is killed by her robots; he helps the villain in a story about Sibyl and the Deke Squad, and he has no tie to anyone filed.
On screen in AoS 5x07, 5x08 and 5x09 as the surface survivor who killed Owen Shaw.

Only on screen in AoS 4x05, a short scene where the jailed gang member tells Robbie the drive-by was a hit and the Ghost Rider burns him; the episode's plot is Lucy's prison riot and getting Eli out, so it does not turn on him, and he has no tie to anyone filed.
Only on screen in AoS 6x04, but she is the girlfriend of Deke Shaw (who has a file) until she leaves him for Trevor Khan.
Only on screen in AoS 1x12, but he is the episode's antagonist: he fakes the freezing attack, knocks out Fitz and builds the storm with Donnie Gill to sell to Ian Quinn.
On screen in AoS 6x01, 6x02, 6x04, 6x05 and 6x07-6x09 as one of Sarge's crew.

Only on screen in AoS 3x03, where he is Hunter's old partner in the side plot who gets him into HYDRA's fight club and dies fighting him; the episode's main plot is Lincoln and the ATCU, and his only family is an unnamed ex-fiancee.
On screen in AoS 3x13 and 3x16 (and in a young flashback in 3x17), and she is the daughter of Gideon Malick, who has a file.
On screen in AoS 1x01 and 1x11, plus flashbacks in 1x11 and 1x15, as the doctor who helped bring Coulson back.
On screen in AoS 5x02, 5x03, 5x06, 5x09 and 5x10, plus a flashback in 7x08, as the Lighthouse trader.

Only alive on screen in AoS 6x01, where he comes through a bad portal fused into a wall, warns of Pachakutiq and dies (6x02 shows only his corpse, and the rest are mentions); he is nobody's boss or relative.
Only on screen in AoS 1x09, but he is the episode's antagonist, the 'ghost' haunting Hannah who attacks the Bus, and it ends when he lets her go.
On screen in AoS 2x14 and 2x15 as an agent on Gonzales's council (2x16 and 2x17 are mentions).
On screen in AoS 5x13, where he leads S.H.I.E.L.D. to Getty, and in 5x19, where he brings Daisy the Centipede files.
Only on screen in AoS 1x06, but he is the case's living victim, the firefighter infected through his Chitauri helmet, whom Coulson sits with before he dies.

Only on screen in AoS 2x06, where he is the bomb-maker Bobbi questions for leads and who is shot dead; this is one short step in a story about Scarlotti, Beckers and the Ward brothers, and his only boss is Whitehall.
On screen in AoS 6x04, 6x05, 6x07 and 6x13 as the undercover agent at Deke's company.
On screen in AoS 5x03, 5x04 and 5x10 as Kasius's trainer of Inhuman fighters.
Only on screen in AoS 4x10, but he is the episode's main antagonist, the Watchdogs-hired assassin whose men hunt Mace after the Quinjet crash until Mack and May beat him.

Only on screen in AoS 5x01 (later episodes only mention him), where he greets Coulson's team as the saviors his True Believers awaited and a Vrellnexian kills him; he is a guide, and he has no tie to anyone filed.
